$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-hover-card__content) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer. Person, Avatar, Names, Name, Role, Body, Separator and Footer are Figma's sample content, drawn the same way in the renderer.

root.$why: The border is outside the box in Figma, drawn as an outer 1 px shadow before the Surface/Popover shadow. Figma's root has no gap around its one slot; code puts the slot's 12 px gap on the card itself. Its height is 1 px taller: Figma's separator is a 0 px line with a centred stroke, the code's a 1 px border in the layout (the pixel check allows it).

content.$why: Figma's content slot is the card's inner box; in code the parts sit directly in the card, which carries the 16 px padding and the 12 px gap.

Avatar.$why: The Avatar's picture box carries the size, radius and fill (as in references/avatar); Figma's auto layout has nothing to lay out.

Separator.$why: Figma's line is 0 px thick with a centred stroke; the code's separator is a 1 px border in the layout.
